simple.meaning: חָלָץ (châlâts) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the loins (as the seat of vigor).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 11 times across Genesis, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Job, Isaiah, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 35:11. Its contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָלָץ (H2504).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: the loins (as the seat of vigor)
definitions.full: H2504. chalats [ חָלָץ ] noun [feminine] only dual, loins (as seat of strength, vigour; compare Aramaic חַרְצָא hip, loin , Syriac , Nö ZMG 1886, 741 ) — חֲלָצָ֑יִם Isa 32:11 ; suffix חֲלָצֶיךָ Gen 35:11 4 t.; חֲלָצָיו Isa 5:27 2 t.; חלצו Kt Job 31:20 , Qr חֲלָצָיו ; — loins: 1 as seat of virility ח מן ׳יצא Gen 35:11 (P), 1Kin 8:19 ; 2Chr 6:9 . 2 as girded ח כְּגֶבֶר ׳נָא אֱזָרֿ Job 38:3 ; 40:7 ; חֲלָצָיו אֵזוֺר Isa 5:27 (see אֵזוֺר ), חֲלָצָ֑יִם עַל וַחֲג֫וֺרָה 32:11 , compare Job 31:20 where the clothed loins are conceived as blessing charitable giver; metaphor Isa 11:5 faithfulness waist-cloth of his loins (|| מתניו ). 3 as seat of pains , like a woman's in travail, Jer 30:6 . [ חֲרַץ ] noun [masculine] loin (see Biblical Hebrew חָלָץ , √ II. [ חָלַץ ]); — suffix חַרְצֵהּ Dan 5:6 the joints of his loin (see קְטַר ).
definitions.rootNote: from 2502 (in the sense of strength ); only in the dual;
